security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Private, local tracker for AI tool usage, cost and limits
bundle.longDescription: Reads usage metadata that Claude Code, Cowork, the Claude desktop app and Codex already write on your computer, keeps a local archive and shows API-equivalent cost and plan limits. No content is stored and nothing leaves your machine.
